notes.title: last HUGE update before release, that adds 2 new endings (V0.9)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733807/33600c2b255e95490063c979c26bb853110f2cca.png[/img]
Hey there Hassan here! yeah this update adds a lot to the game, and will be the last update before the game release in 2 months (tho might still release a quality of life update/hotfixes/localization)

this took a long time to finish, I'm proud to say the game is almost done, been a journey guys thanks fr sticking with me 

This update makes the game also overall better, visually and bug wise.

hope you like it, and more importantly like the full release, if you have an recommendations or critiques please do comment it here or dm on any platform (https://discord.gg/ZjD2ZxtT)

-Your favorite game dev pal

notes.title: Achievements are coming to Deepophobia!
notes.content:
Hey there, Hassan here! I have recently added steam achievements in the game! this is something I wanted for a while, I even made a whole system for it before to work independently from steam....but turns out it crashes the game if someone plays it outside the editor lol. Like seriously I had it like that for like a month till I tried it and it just crashed or just made you do nothing.
Now I use steam's built in achievements and they were so easy to implement.

[h1][b]ART STYLE[/b][/h1]
Unlocked achievement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733807/07ecad3ccdb416552478a6890a57667b188a1953.png[/img]
Locked achievement 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733807/364e3672d731b4d35831139473ad8229ee42b1f4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733807/b7f1da45a007bfb86ff733d573d41f3977d6ea2e.png[/img]
The art took a bit of time to get it right but wasn't too hard, as you can see it is very simple and I like that.
I took inspiration from tf2's achievements' art style and it turned out pretty good

notes.title: Plenty Sounds Update!
notes.content:
Hey there, Hassan here! I did quite a few things for this update like adding a a whole new character, the baby Kraken and fixed a few bugs but the best thing is the new sounds!, from the new main menu music to new kraken crackling voice but I can't take credit for these sounds as a kind person(Seán Bennett) reached out and did them for [i]free[/i]!


[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Well maybe a bit less stuff for the next 2-3 weeks as I have exams, but I'll definitely squeeze in some work here and there. I have been experimenting with adding chess to the game with a working AI using machine learning..... why? I don't man I like chess and this is so far going to be more work than it's worth but I am too deep in it to stop lol

Till the next update
-Your Favorite Game Dev
